name: testimonial-basic
title: Testimonial Basic
description: A white editorial page stacked with review rows. Each row pairs a wide video thumbnail with a play badge and timecode next to a rounded avatar, bold name, monospaced role, an oversized quotation and five gold stars.
use: A coaching, course or SaaS page wants rich proof rows that pair a video still with a long quote and a rating.
avoid: The play buttons are decorative and start nothing, and all three reviews with their media are hardcoded.
a11y: Play badges are spans inside a clickable-looking row with no action or keyboard reach, and alt text for the stills is generic. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: White page framed by thin grey rules, with a small spaced "« TESTIMONIALS »" label and a very large black uppercase title. Rows pair a landscape video still with a white play button and timecode against a rounded avatar, heavy name, mono role, large quote and five gold stars.
behaves: The rows stack down the page and scroll normally. Hovering a video still nudges the photo slightly larger and grows the play badge; nothing else moves and no video plays.
customise: The three reviews, quotes, ratings, avatars and video stills are hardcoded; the stripe texture and column widths need source edits.
weight: light: Static photos and text with CSS hover scales; nothing animates on its own.
